Bathroom Remodeling in Park City, KS

Park City is an incorporated community on Wichita's north edge — its own city government, its own building department, and a housing stock that skews 1960s through 1990s residential. These are established north Wichita homes on mature lots, and their bathrooms reflect the era in which they were built: functional until they weren't, and now clearly past due for renovation.

Park City's bathroom inventory runs heavy on the 1970s–1980s package: fiberglass surround over a steel tub in the primary bath, ceramic floor tile in small format, a builder vanity in the era-appropriate wood tone, and an exhaust fan that may or may not have ever worked correctly. This is the bathroom that needs to be completely redone — not patched, not refreshed, redone.

Wheatland Construction serves Park City and north Sedgwick County. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018.

Park City Bathroom Remodeling Specifics

Older north Wichita construction: 1960s–1970s Park City homes may have galvanized supply lines and older drain infrastructure. We assess before pricing — not after demo.

Full bathroom conversions are common here: The primary bath in a typical 1970s Park City home has the original tub/shower alcove and original everything. The most common scope is a full conversion: remove the fiberglass and tub, frame and waterproof a walk-in shower, tile, glass panel, new vanity, new fixtures, new fan. One scope, total transformation.

Guest bath preservation: If the hall bath has the only tub in the house, we discuss resale implications before converting it. We give honest advice.

Permits in Park City

City of Park City Building Department — Park City has its own building inspection division. We handle all permit applications and inspections.

How We Approach Bathroom Remodeling in

Every bathroom remodel in starts with an in-person assessment. We walk the existing bathroom with you, look at what's behind the walls where it matters (around the tub/shower surround, under the vanity, at the subfloor where it meets the tub), and give you an honest read on what the project actually involves before any numbers get discussed.

We price in writing. Every line item - demo, plumbing, tile, vanity, fixtures, exhaust, permit - is documented before work starts. No surprises mid-project.

Our crew handles demo through final walkthrough. We don't hand off your project to a rotating cast of subcontractors who don't know each other's work. The people who pull the permits are the people who do the work and stand behind it.

Wheatland Construction has held Veterans Approved Builder status (ID: 00899) since we opened and has been Home Advisor Certified since 2019. We're licensed and insured in Kansas. If something isn't right at the final walkthrough, we fix it before we consider the project done.

Frequently Asked Questions About Bathroom Remodeling in Park City

How much does bathroom remodeling cost in Park City, KS?

Park City bathroom remodels range from $8,000 for a targeted refresh to $25,000+ for a full primary bath renovation. Most full primary bath conversions in Park City run $13,000–$20,000. Written, line-item estimates.

Do I need permits for bathroom remodeling in Park City?

Yes — Park City has its own building inspection division separate from Wichita and Sedgwick County. We handle all permit applications and inspections.

What's the most common bathroom remodel scope in Park City?

Full walk-in shower conversion in the primary bath: demo the original fiberglass tub/shower alcove, frame and waterproof a walk-in shower with membrane system, install large-format porcelain tile, frameless glass panel, updated fixtures, new vanity with quartz top. Complete transformation.

My Park City home's primary bath has the only tub — should I convert it to a walk-in shower?

If it's the only tub in the house, a walk-in conversion reduces resale appeal for buyers with young children. If you plan to stay long-term or have a second tub elsewhere, the conversion is the right call for daily quality of life. We talk through this at the consultation.

How long does a Park City bathroom remodel take?

2–4 weeks for most projects. Walk-in shower conversions with full tile work may run 3–5 weeks.

Does bathroom remodeling add value in Park City?

Yes. Established north Wichita locations with their own city character maintain property values well. Updated bathrooms are a top-line value driver in Park City's resale market.
